name.baseName: Sulphate pulp, ECF bleached, at plant

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Modern average technology.

# Included processes
This module includes the production of sulphate pulp with the ECF bleaching process - including transports to the pulp mill, wood handling, chemical pulping and bleaching, drying process, energy production on-site, recovery cycles of chemicals and internal waste water treatment.; Geography: Data from a finnish database and from several Scandinavian producers used as European average data.
